paper.title: Type of anesthesia for cancer resection surgery: No differential impact on cancer recurrence in mouse models of breast cancer

checks.label: Hypothesis stated
checks.question: Does the paper explicitly state the scientific hypothesis or primary research question being tested?
checks.quote: We hypothesized that choice of anesthetic agent (volatile sevoflurane vs intravenous propofol) during primary tumor resection affects metastatic recurrence.

checks.label: Primary outcome defined
checks.question: Is the primary experimental outcome clearly defined in advance?
checks.quote: The primary outcome measure was bioluminescence flux indicating lung metastatic burden 28 days post-resection.

checks.label: Control group
checks.question: Is a proper vehicle, sham, or negative control group included in the experimental design?
checks.quote: Vehicle control mice received equivalent volume saline infusions and sham laparotomy without resection.

checks.label: Group sizes reported
checks.question: Are exact sample sizes (n per group) explicitly reported for each experimental condition?
checks.quote: Animals were allocated into sevoflurane (n = 15), propofol (n = 15), and unoperated control (n = 10) groups across 3 independent cohorts.

checks.label: Sample size justified
checks.question: Is a formal power calculation or sample size justification provided?
checks.quote: No formal a priori power calculation was performed; sample sizes were chosen based on previous pilot experience.

checks.label: Randomization
checks.question: Were experimental subjects randomly allocated to treatment groups?
checks.quote: Mice bearing orthotopic tumors of comparable size were randomized into anesthetic intervention arms.

checks.label: Randomization method
checks.question: Is the specific random allocation sequence generation method described?
checks.quote: The specific algorithm or sequence generator for randomization was not detailed in the text.

checks.label: Blinded allocation
checks.question: Was allocation sequence concealed until interventions were assigned?
checks.quote: Concealment of allocation prior to surgery was not reported.

checks.label: Blinded assessment
checks.question: Were outcome assessors blinded to the treatment condition during scoring?
checks.quote: Bioluminescence and histological lung nodule counts were quantified by investigators blinded to animal treatment arm.

checks.label: Inclusion criteria
checks.question: Are pre-specified inclusion and exclusion criteria for animal subjects detailed?
checks.quote: Female BALB/c mice aged 8–10 weeks with established palpable mammary tumors were included.

checks.label: Exclusions reported
checks.question: Are all animal exclusions, mortalities, or attrition clearly reported with reasons?
checks.quote: Two animals in the propofol group died during induction and were excluded from final survival analysis.

checks.label: Independent replication
checks.question: Were primary findings replicated across independent experimental runs?
checks.quote: All surgical experiments were independently repeated in three distinct biological cohorts with concordant recurrence rates.

checks.label: Replicate type defined
checks.question: Is the distinction between biological and technical replicates explicitly stated?
checks.quote: Distinction between biological vs technical replicates was not formally defined in figure legends.
